read.en: Alphabet rose 1.3% on Oct 28 to $324.89, trading between $322.65 and $326.40 on 2.2 times average volume. It is above the falling 5-day average ($321.3) and below the falling 10-day ($331.6), 30-day ($341.7), 100-day ($347.2) and 200-day ($341.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($342.53), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月28日上涨 1.3%，收于 $324.89，盘中区间 $322.65–326.40，成交量为均量的 2.2 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$321.3）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$331.6）、30 日（$341.7）、100 日（$347.2）和 200 日均线（$341.2）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$342.53），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close cleared $322–324.5 (5-day, Oct 22 low, Oct 23 high), now support; the high stopped at $326.4. Resistance is $326.4 (Oct 28 high), then $331.4–331.6 (Oct 22 high, 10-day) and $341.2–342.5 (200-day, SAR). Support is $321.3–322.7 (5-day, Oct 28 low), then $316.6–319.4 and $314.9 (Jul 23 low). A close above $326.4 would target $331.5; below $321.3, $316.6–319.
